name: What types of attic insulation are available, and which is best?

mainEntity.name: What types of attic insulation are available, and which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common types of attic insulation include fiberglass batts, blown-in fiberglass, and blown-in cellulose. Fiberglass batts are pre-cut sections, often used for standard joist spacing. Blown-in fiberglass and cellulose are loose-fill materials, ideal for filling irregular spaces, around obstructions, and for achieving high R-values in existing attics. Each type has its benefits regarding cost, installation, and R-value per inch. The 'best' type depends on your attic's specific layout, existing insulation, budget, and desired R-value. A professional can help assess your attic and recommend the most suitable material.
